title: Biased Tales: Cultural and Topic Bias in Generating Children’s Stories

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring surface-level word correlations (Pearson) in generated story text and extracted protagonist attributes based on child gender and parental role, and predicting gender directly from the text using a TF-IDF vectorized feed-forward neural network.

Analyzing word correlations and context-centric attributes (e.g., geographic location, urban setting, socioeconomic status) across 28 different parent nationalities, and measuring the predictability of a nationality and its economic development status from the story text.
Using Pearson correlation to identify stereotypical associations between specific vocabulary or character attributes in the generated stories and the specified ethnicity of the parent.
Correlating generated story vocabulary and character traits with the specified religion of the parent, and evaluating the predictability of the religion from the text.
